scripts.setup: npm run data && npm run fonts
scripts.fonts: mkdir -p public/fonts && for f in SamsungOne-400 SamsungOne-700 SamsungSharpSansBd; do curl -sfL -A Mozilla/5.0 -e https://www.samsung.com/tr/innovation-campus/ https://www.samsung.com/etc.clientlibs/samsung/clientlibs/consumer/global/clientlib-common/resources/fonts/$f.woff2 -o public/fonts/$f.woff2; done
